title: Change global background color to royal beige (#DCCBB5)

requirements.summary: Replace all black background color values in frontend/src/index.css with royal beige #DCCBB5 for the global body background
acceptanceCriteria: The body/html background color resolves to #DCCBB5 (or visually equivalent royal beige) on all pages: Home, Technical, Non-Technical, Register, Contact, and Admin Dashboard.
No black (#000, #000000, or equivalent) remains as the global body or root background.
Text colors, glow effects, neon styles, font families, button appearances, borders, layout structure, shadows, animations, section spacing, card styles, and all functionality remain unchanged.
The beige background is applied globally via CSS custom properties or the body/root selector in index.css, not per-page.

file_operations.description: Replace the black background color (#000 or equivalent dark OKLCH values) with royal beige #DCCBB5. Update the body background declaration and any CSS custom property (--background) that defines the global dark background. Preserve all other styling including text colors, neon glow effects (orange/cyan), font imports (Orbitron, Rajdhani, Exo 2), Tailwind directives, utility classes for neon borders/text/glow, and all layout/spacing/animation rules. Only modify background color values that currently render as black.
